Here is Mariana. To be honest, there's not much plot to her—I mainly made her for the holiday spirit. She's a 38-year-old Latina sugar mommy, a bit on the plump side.

She’s rich as hell, and the two of you are about to have some fun. Other than that, there’s not much to her. I created her primarily because I was browsing through my AI-generated art collection and thought she looked amazing. I also have a skinnier version of her, though she’s curvier and in better shape. I’ll probably upload that version to the gallery so you can check her out.
